layer_note: Places mentioned in videos on Ken Ham's channel (Answers in Genesis). AiG promotes a young-earth creation view that most scientists reject; pins report what was said, without endorsement.

properties.name: Durupınar formation, near Doğubayazıt, Ağrı Province, Turkey
properties.found: A boat-shaped landform about 30 km south of Mount Ararat, near the Iran border. A private group said in 2025 that soil and radar scans hint at old wood. Geologists, including creationist ones at Answers in Genesis, say it is a natural fold in the rock. No dig has been allowed.
properties.notes: Mentions (paraphrased): ~0:02: Responds to 2025 news from Turkey claiming Noah's Ark was found; says the Durupınar site is a natural rock formation, not the ark.

related_videos.title: Responds to 2025 news from Turkey claiming Noah's Ark was found; says the Durupınar site is a natural rock formation, not the ark.
related_videos.label: Ken Ham (Answers in Genesis) · ~0:02

properties.caveat: Ark claims are disputed. AiG rejects this site but holds a young-earth view of a global flood that most scientists do not share. Pin marks the formation, not a confirmed ark.

properties.name: Guadalupe River, Kerrville area, Kerr County, Texas
properties.found: On July 4, 2025, heavy rain made the Guadalupe River rise about 36 feet. Kerr County officials later listed about 119 people killed there, including 27 campers and counselors at Camp Mystic.
properties.notes: Mentions (paraphrased): ~0:00: Broadcast from the Texas Hill Country above the Guadalupe River after the July 2025 floods; talks about where God is in tragedy.

related_videos.title: Broadcast from the Texas Hill Country above the Guadalupe River after the July 2025 floods; talks about where God is in tragedy.
related_videos.label: Ken Ham (Answers in Genesis) · ~0:00

properties.caveat: Exact filming spot not stated; pin set at Kerrville. Death counts changed as reports were updated.
